elements.name: inside of an old country bus
head turned to the side window
steep forested mountain slopes of Ethiopian highlands

wrong_setting: The scene is a wooden-framed room or lookout with floor-to-ceiling glass and a plank floor, not the interior of a bus; there are no seats or bus fittings.
notes: Repaint the scene as a bus interior seen from the seat behind, with worn seat backs. The young man should sit in the window seat with his head turned toward the window and the backpack on his knees, not standing in a cabin with the bag on his back.
